newsitem.title: USA: Dominion Resources unit to sell $800 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Resources unit to sell $800 mln debt.

text.p: DR Investment, a unit of Dominion Resources Inc, will issue about $800 million in a two-tranche debt deal next week via Lehman Brothers, a Dominion Resources company official said on Thursday.
The Baa1/A-minus rated issue is expected to consist of five- and 10-year noncallable bullet maturities, he said.
The proceeds will replace bridge financing in connection with the company's purchase of East Midlands Electricity Plc, he added.
Dominion Resources closed on the acquistion in the first quarter of 1997.
The debt is not guaranteed by the parent company.
